title: Overview: Thermo-Reactive Window Shading Materials
description: Window films and coatings that automatically darken or lighten in response to temperature, no wiring needed. Materials are the foundation under every other technology: lighter, stronger, smarter matter makes everything built on top of it better. This database covers all the pieces needed to make it: core components, materials, processes, software, and subsystems, organized on a teaching ladder from Foundations to Advanced. Every record is the full entry with definitions, key facts, and a runnable demo program.

title: Signature design: Glossary & Quick Reference
description: Signature design: The working vocabulary of Thermo-Reactive Window Shading Materials: Nanostructure, Composite, Yield strength, Fatigue life, Percolation, Sintering, Doping, Toughness.
definition: Glossary for Thermo-Reactive Window Shading Materials.
key_points: Nanostructure: Engineered features at the billionth-of-a-meter scale that set material properties.
Composite: Two or more materials combined so the whole outperforms each part.
Yield strength: The stress where a material starts to deform permanently.
Fatigue life: How many load cycles a material survives before cracking.
Percolation: The loading where filler particles connect into a conductive network.
Sintering: Fusing powder particles with heat into a solid part.
Doping: Adding trace elements to tune electrical or optical behavior.
Toughness: Energy a material absorbs before fracturing — strength plus ductility.
